questions.question:
**Choose the most appropriate word that can substitute the given group of words.**

A group of Lions
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Pride'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****

All the options are **collective nouns of animal and bird groups.**

Let us look into the meaning of the given words:

 
• **Herd:** a large group of animals, especially hoofed mammals, that live together.
 
• **Pack:** a group of wild animals, especially wolves, living and hunting together.
 
• **Flock:** a number of birds of one kind feeding, resting, or travelling together.
 
• **Pride:** a group of lions or birds, such as ostriches or peacocks.

Thus, a group of lions is called a** 'pride'.**

questions.question:
**Choose the most appropriate word that can substitute the given group of words.**

A person pretending to be somebody he isn't
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Hypocrite.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Hypocrite"** refers to a person who pretends to have beliefs, opinions, virtues, or feelings that they do not truly possess. (पाखंडी)

 
 
• **Example: **She called him a hypocrite because he said he cared about the environment but always drove a gas-guzzler.
 
 
 
• **Bureaucrat **refers to an official in a government department, in particular one perceived as being concerned with procedural correctness at the expense of people's needs. (नौकरशाह)
 
 
• **Example: **The bureaucrat was known for his diligent adherence to the rules.
 
 
 
• **Aristocrat **refers to a member of the aristocracy; someone from a high social class. (अभिजात वर्ग का सदस्य)
 
 
• **Example: **As an aristocrat, she was accustomed to a life of luxury.
 
 
 
• **Conservative** refers to a person who is averse to change and holds traditional values. (परंपरावादी)
 
 
• **Example: **The conservative politician opposed the new progressive policies.
 
 
 
• Hence, a hypocrite is someone who pretends to be somebody he isn't.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Hypocrite.

questions.question:

questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Let us look into the meaning of the options one by one:

__
 
• **Except:** other than.
 
• **Unless:** except if.
 
• **Because: **for the reason that.
 
• **Whether**: choice between alternatives.

A condition is indicated in the given sentence. So, the right word is **'unless'.**

Correct sentence__: ***We cannot quote a price unless we are allowed to examine the sample.***

questions.question:

It would take up few of my time to explain to you the whole case.

options.text: explain to you the whole case

questions.solution:
The erroneous part is** 'few of my time to'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****

__
 
• **Few-**- is used for countable nouns. Here, the word **Time** is an uncountable noun.
 
• The correct idiom is '**take up too much of my time** which means to occupy a lot of time in a wasteful manner.

So the correct sentence:__ *It would **take up too much of my time** to explain to you the whole case. *
